records.reason: The remove_row rationale overstates the source when it treats Hussam, Porter and Smith (2008), Thar She Blows: Can Bubbles Be Rekindled with Experienced Subjects? as only background or a methodological comparator. Section II.F attributes the experience finding to the cited set, specifically names Hussam and Sutter for the empirical comparison, actually tests attenuation of RD/RDMAX/RAD with experience in new data, and calls those tests conceptual replications. Step 2 judges the retested relationship, not a direct-replication label or a requirement that a test be tied exclusively to one paper. The explicit contrary statement that these tests are not tied to one specific study and revisit a stylized fact is material, but does not by itself dispose of this original-specific relationship. Both named comparators need a substantive scope decision; the paper does not test every claim of either original. This is an objection to the categorical removal rationale, not a final retention adjudication. All six shipped counterparts were checked: Hussam 2008, Sutter 2012, CDP 2018, AOL, EF 2015 and KLS. The references identify these works by authors/title/venue; printed shortDOIs or differing citation years alone do not prove an omission, a different original, or a correction.
